transition: NZDT begins. At 2026-09-27T02:00 local the clocks jump to 03:00, so no local wall time from 02:00 to 02:59 exists at all.
why_it_is_here: SPEC.md §2.8: a Publisher MUST NOT emit a local_wall that does not exist in the zone. A naive local-time parse of 02:30 either throws or slides an hour without saying so, and an Occasion published an hour from where it runs is worse than one that was refused. Deriving the wall clock FORWARD from an instant cannot produce a gap time, which is why the direction is load-bearing rather than a convention.

before.label: the last instant before the jump

publisher_error.note: The instant is real — +12:00 was still in force one minute earlier — but it lands at 03:30 local, not the 02:30 the Publisher wrote down. An hour, silently, on the one night of the year a marathon is running.
